column1: # Games hidden from the catalog — dropped by the importers and deleted from
# the database on every refresh, so they never show in the portal, picks or
# the MCP server. Hiding here does NOT remove anything from the store account.
# Keyed on (store, store_id), NOT games.id — stable across DB rebuilds.
# A game owned in several stores stays visible until every one of its store
# store:    steam | epic | gog | amazon | gamepass | lutris
#           (only the Heroic importer — epic, gog, amazon — skips them at
#           import; rows from other stores are deleted right after)
# store_id: shown as store:store_id under "Where to play" on the portal page
# Keep your own copy at ~/.config/game-catalog/hidden-games.tsv (the scripts read
# that one when it exists); this repo copy is only the empty template.
